scope: a236–a268: 33 electrical/electronics courses, 792 steps, 396 technical units; original bilingual teaching text and calculations, source links only.

courses.title: 海上風機發電機整合
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

stages.title: 能量與傳動
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成能量與傳動；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete energy and drivetrain through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識能量邊界：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Define energy boundaries: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識能量邊界，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand define energy boundaries through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識能量邊界」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If define energy boundaries disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識能量邊界」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for define energy boundaries, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 辨識能量邊界：證據

knowledge.textEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：15 MW、10 rpm 時，ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s，軸轉矩 T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m；若機電效率 96%，15 MW 軸輸入只得 14.4 MW 電輸出。這是量綱練習，不是參考風機額定規格。 穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: at 15 MW and 10 rpm, ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s and shaft torque T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m. With 96% electromechanical efficiency, 15 MW shaft input yields 14.4 MW electrical output. This is a dimensional exercise, not a reference-turbine rating. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

optionsEn: Flow power ρAv³/2 is not entirely extractable shaft power.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 風流功率 ρAv³/2 不是可全數擷取的軸功率。 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow power ρAv³/2 is not entirely extractable shaft power. At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953.

courses.title: 風機變流器與電氣保護
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討背對背變流器、直流匯流排與故障穿越的能量協調，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore energy coordination of back-to-back converters, DC links and fault ride-through, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。穿越曲線、無功優先與跳脫時限須取自實際併網規範；本課不提供現場保護設定。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Ride-through curves, reactive-current priority and trip delays come from the actual grid code; this course does not prescribe field protection settings.

stages.title: 拓樸與座標
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成拓樸與座標；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete topology and frames through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.instruction: 以 0.2 滑差作量級比較，並指出轉子暫態電流不能僅用平均滑差估算。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Use slip 0.2 for an order-of-magnitude comparison and flag rotor transient current as a separate constraint. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：C=20 mF 的直流電容從 1,000 V 升至 1,100 V，ΔE=C(V₂²−V₁²)/2=2.10 kJ。若機側比網側多輸入 100 kW，只需約 21 ms 累積這份能量，忽略損耗。 穿越曲線、無功優先與跳脫時限須取自實際併網規範；本課不提供現場保護設定。

courses.title: 風場集電系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討海纜電容、集電拓樸、熱額定與選擇性保護，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore subsea-cable capacitance, collector topology, thermal ratings and selective protection, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。集中參數模型只適合對應頻段與長度；暫態、局部放電及海床熱阻須用專用模型與量測。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Lumped models apply only within their frequency and length range; transients, partial discharge and seabed thermal resistance need dedicated models and measurements.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較 N−1 承載，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare n−1 loading through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 按同一假設出力跑正常與 N−1 潮流，列出首個越限支路。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Run normal and N−1 flows at the same assumed output and list the first overloaded branch. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 按同一假設出力跑正常與 N−1 潮流，列出首個越限支路。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Run normal and N−1 flows at the same assumed output and list the first overloaded branch. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較 N−1 承載」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把海纜電容、集電拓樸、熱額定與選擇性保護的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare n−1 loading disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of subsea-cable capacitance, collector topology, thermal ratings and selective protection behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較 N−1 承載」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare n−1 loading, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 比較 N−1 承載：證據
knowledge.text: 按同一假設出力跑正常與 N−1 潮流，列出首個越限支路。
knowledge.textEn: Run normal and N−1 flows at the same assumed output and list the first overloaded branch.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：平衡三相 30 MW、66 kV、功率因數 0.95，I=P/(√3·VLL·PF)=276.2 A。每相 R=0.6 Ω 時總銅損 3I²R≈137.3 kW；忽略充電電流後的結果不能直接用於長海纜選型。 集中參數模型只適合對應頻段與長度；暫態、局部放電及海床熱阻須用專用模型與量測。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: balanced 30 MW at 66 kV and power factor 0.95 gives I=P/(√3·VLL·PF)=276.2 A. At R=0.6 Ω per phase, total copper loss 3I²R≈137.3 kW. Neglecting charging current makes this insufficient for long-cable selection. Lumped models apply only within their frequency and length range; transients, partial discharge and seabed thermal resistance need dedicated models and measurements.

以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
After a branch outage, rerouting may exceed another thermal limit; connectivity is not feasibility.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 一條支路故障後轉供可能超過另一條熱額定，拓樸連通不代表可行。 按同一假設出力跑正常與 N−1 潮流，列出首個越限支路。
quiz.explanationEn: After a branch outage, rerouting may exceed another thermal limit; connectivity is not feasibility. Run normal and N−1 flows at the same assumed output and list the first overloaded branch.

courses.title: 抽蓄電站電氣控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討水力儲能、可變速機組與抽發模式切換的控制邊界，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore hydraulic storage, variable-speed machines and pumping/generation control boundaries, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。水頭和效率隨工況改變；本課只做離線調度與狀態機分析，不是水輪機現場啟停程序。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Head and efficiency vary with operating point; this is offline dispatch and state-machine analysis, not a field turbine starting procedure.

stages.descriptionEn: Complete water and machinery through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識感測器漂移：建立模型

courses.title: 電池儲能電站整合
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討儲能電池、功率變流器與能源管理的分層整合，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore layered battery, power-converter and energy-management integration, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。容量、消防、併網與建築條件均需專案審核；本課是離線系統整合模型，不提供電池櫃施工與帶電測試程序。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Capacity, fire response, interconnection and building conditions need project review; this is an offline integration model, not cabinet construction or energized testing.

stages.title: 容量與拓樸
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成容量與拓樸；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete capacity and topology through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 區分 MW 與 MWh：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Distinguish MW and MWh: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解區分 MW 與 MWh，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand distinguish mw and mwh through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 比較 1 MW/4 MWh 與 4 MW/1 MWh 面對相同 2 MW 負載的可行性。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare 1 MW/4 MWh and 4 MW/1 MWh systems serving the same 2 MW load. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 比較 1 MW/4 MWh 與 4 MW/1 MWh 面對相同 2 MW 負載的可行性。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare 1 MW/4 MWh and 4 MW/1 MWh systems serving the same 2 MW load. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「區分 MW 與 MWh」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把儲能電池、功率變流器與能源管理的分層整合的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If distinguish mw and mwh disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of layered battery, power-converter and energy-management integration behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「區分 MW 與 MWh」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for distinguish mw and mwh, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 功率限制瞬時輸出，能量限制持續時間，兩者不可互換。
knowledge.textEn: Power limits instantaneous output; energy limits duration; they are not interchangeable.

knowledge.title: 區分 MW 與 MWh：證據
knowledge.text: 比較 1 MW/4 MWh 與 4 MW/1 MWh 面對相同 2 MW 負載的可行性。
knowledge.textEn: Compare 1 MW/4 MWh and 4 MW/1 MWh systems serving the same 2 MW load.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：2 MWh 名目電池只在 SOC 10–90% 間運轉，可用 DC 能量 1.6 MWh；若放電鏈效率 95%，AC 交付約 1.52 MWh。以 1 MW 定功率可維持 1.52 h，尚未計入溫度與老化降額。 容量、消防、併網與建築條件均需專案審核；本課是離線系統整合模型，不提供電池櫃施工與帶電測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 2 MWh nominal battery operated between 10% and 90% SOC offers 1.6 MWh DC energy. At 95% discharge-chain efficiency it delivers about 1.52 MWh AC, or 1.52 hours at 1 MW, before temperature and aging derating. Capacity, fire response, interconnection and building conditions need project review; this is an offline integration model, not cabinet construction or energized testing.

knowledge.textEn: Simulate RC charging to about 95% at 3τ and state that this is not a field timing setting.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：2 MWh 名目電池只在 SOC 10–90% 間運轉，可用 DC 能量 1.6 MWh；若放電鏈效率 95%，AC 交付約 1.52 MWh。以 1 MW 定功率可維持 1.52 h，尚未計入溫度與老化降額。 容量、消防、併網與建築條件均需專案審核；本課是離線系統整合模型，不提供電池櫃施工與帶電測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 2 MWh nominal battery operated between 10% and 90% SOC offers 1.6 MWh DC energy. At 95% discharge-chain efficiency it delivers about 1.52 MWh AC, or 1.52 hours at 1 MW, before temperature and aging derating. Capacity, fire response, interconnection and building conditions need project review; this is an offline integration model, not cabinet construction or energized testing.

quiz.question: 關於「建立預充概念模型：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Build a precharge concept model: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 離線模擬 RC 充電至 3τ 約 95%，明示這不是現場接線時間設定。
只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: Simulate RC charging to about 95% at 3τ and state that this is not a field timing setting.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: DC 電容連接瞬間的電壓差會造成衝擊，控制須辨識充電完成證據。 離線模擬 RC 充電至 3τ 約 95%，明示這不是現場接線時間設定。
quiz.explanationEn: A voltage difference across a DC capacitor creates inrush; control needs evidence of charging completion. Simulate RC charging to about 95% at 3τ and state that this is not a field timing setting.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解整合 PCS 能力曲線，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand integrate pcs capability curves through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將功率圓與兩個降額工況疊合，找出不能提供的無功承諾。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay a power circle with two derated cases and identify unavailable VAR commitments. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將功率圓與兩個降額工況疊合，找出不能提供的無功承諾。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Overlay a power circle with two derated cases and identify unavailable VAR commitments. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「整合 PCS 能力曲線」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把儲能電池、功率變流器與能源管理的分層整合的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If integrate pcs capability curves disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of layered battery, power-converter and energy-management integration behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「整合 PCS 能力曲線」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for integrate pcs capability curves, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立異常隔離矩陣，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build a fault-isolation matrix through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「單串故障與全站緊急停機的影響範圍不同。」的觀察。移除一串後重算可用功率、能量及不平衡，保留故障紀錄。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: A single-string fault and plant emergency stop have different scopes. Remove one string and recompute power, energy and imbalance while retaining the event record. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 移除一串後重算可用功率、能量及不平衡，保留故障紀錄。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Remove one string and recompute power, energy and imbalance while retaining the event record. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立異常隔離矩陣」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把儲能電池、功率變流器與能源管理的分層整合的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build a fault-isolation matrix disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of layered battery, power-converter and energy-management integration behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立異常隔離矩陣」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build a fault-isolation matrix, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立異常隔離矩陣：原理
knowledge.text: 單串故障與全站緊急停機的影響範圍不同。
knowledge.textEn: A single-string fault and plant emergency stop have different scopes.

knowledge.title: 建立異常隔離矩陣：證據
knowledge.text: 移除一串後重算可用功率、能量及不平衡，保留故障紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Remove one string and recompute power, energy and imbalance while retaining the event record.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：2 MWh 名目電池只在 SOC 10–90% 間運轉，可用 DC 能量 1.6 MWh；若放電鏈效率 95%，AC 交付約 1.52 MWh。以 1 MW 定功率可維持 1.52 h，尚未計入溫度與老化降額。 容量、消防、併網與建築條件均需專案審核；本課是離線系統整合模型，不提供電池櫃施工與帶電測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 2 MWh nominal battery operated between 10% and 90% SOC offers 1.6 MWh DC energy. At 95% discharge-chain efficiency it delivers about 1.52 MWh AC, or 1.52 hours at 1 MW, before temperature and aging derating. Capacity, fire response, interconnection and building conditions need project review; this is an offline integration model, not cabinet construction or energized testing.

quiz.question: 關於「建立異常隔離矩陣：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？

options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
移除一串後重算可用功率、能量及不平衡，保留故障紀錄。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Remove one string and recompute power, energy and imbalance while retaining the event record.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 單串故障與全站緊急停機的影響範圍不同。 移除一串後重算可用功率、能量及不平衡，保留故障紀錄。

courses.title: 鋰離子電池管理系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討單體量測、SOC 估測、均衡與分層保護，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore cell measurements, SOC estimation, balancing and layered protection, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。保護門檻依電芯化學、溫度、廠商與設計而異；不提供可直接燒錄的通用電池保護設定。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Protection thresholds depend on chemistry, temperature, supplier and design; no universal flashable protection settings are provided.

steps.title: 標記單體與電池組：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解標記單體與電池組，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.instruction: 用四顆電壓總和相同、分布不同的兩組資料比較風險。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

knowledge.title: 標記單體與電池組：原理
knowledge.text: 包電壓正常仍可能包含一顆過高或過低的單體。

knowledge.text: 用四顆電壓總和相同、分布不同的兩組資料比較風險。
knowledge.textEn: Compare two four-cell datasets with equal total voltage but different distributions.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：100 Ah 電池放電 10 A、30 分鐘，理想電量減少 5 Ah，SOC 下降 5 個百分點。若電流偏移 +0.1 A 持續 10 h，積分誤差 1 Ah=1 個百分點；不能以更多顯示小數消除此偏差。 保護門檻依電芯化學、溫度、廠商與設計而異；不提供可直接燒錄的通用電池保護設定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 100 Ah battery discharged at 10 A for 30 minutes loses ideally 5 Ah, or 5 percentage points SOC. A +0.1 A current offset for 10 hours integrates to 1 Ah, or 1 percentage point; more display decimals do not remove this bias. Protection thresholds depend on chemistry, temperature, supplier and design; no universal flashable protection settings are provided.

courses.title: 液流電池功率介面
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討液流電池電化學、泵浦輔機與雙向電力介面，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore flow-battery electrochemistry, pump auxiliaries and bidirectional interfaces, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電解液種類、堆疊阻抗與泵流條件依系統而異；本課無化學配製、壓力管路或現場通電程序。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.

stages.title: 電解液與堆疊
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成電解液與堆疊；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete electrolyte and stacks through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

knowledge.text: 教學例：假設堆疊輸出 100 kW、泵浦與輔機共 6 kW、PCS 效率 96%，AC 淨輸出=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW。輔機從哪一側供電會改變能量帳，必須先畫邊界。 電解液種類、堆疊阻抗與泵流條件依系統而異；本課無化學配製、壓力管路或現場通電程序。

Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assume 100 kW stack output, 6 kW pump/auxiliary load and 96% PCS efficiency. Net AC output=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW. The accounting changes with auxiliary supply location, so draw the boundary first. Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.

quiz.question: 關於「分開功率與能量設計：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Separate power and energy sizing: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
比較同堆疊配兩種槽量的持續時間，指出不能因此任意倍增功率。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Compare duration for one stack with two tank sizes and explain why power cannot simply double.
quiz.explanation: 儲液量主要影響能量，堆疊面積與數量主要影響功率，但泵和電壓仍耦合。 比較同堆疊配兩種槽量的持續時間，指出不能因此任意倍增功率。
quiz.explanationEn: Tank inventory mainly influences energy and stacks influence power, with pumping and voltage coupling remaining. Compare duration for one stack with two tank sizes and explain why power cannot simply double.

courses.title: 飛輪儲能電機控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討旋轉動能、雙向電機與飛輪損耗管理，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore rotational energy, bidirectional machines and flywheel loss management, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。飛輪破裂、真空與軸承失效有重大實體風險；僅做離線能量及控制建模，不提供轉子製造或超速測試程序。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

steps.title: 匹配電機轉矩包絡：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解匹配電機轉矩包絡，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand match the torque envelope through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 用 T=P/ω 比較同 10 kW 下高低轉速的兩倍轉矩需求。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Use T=P/ω to compare a twofold torque demand between high and low speed at 10 kW. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. courses.title: 不斷電系統設計
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.

stages.title: 負載與拓樸
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成負載與拓樸；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete loads and topology through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立負載清單：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build a load inventory: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立負載清單，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build a load inventory through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立負載清單」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build a load inventory disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立負載清單」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build a load inventory, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立負載清單：原理
knowledge.text: 額定 W、VA、浪湧及峰值因數分別限制供電能力。
knowledge.textEn: Watts, VA, inrush and crest factor impose different supply constraints.

knowledge.title: 建立負載清單：證據
knowledge.text: 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：負載 8 kW、功率因數 0.8，需 10 kVA；這不代表 10 kVA UPS 一定能提供 10 kW。若可用電池能量 4 kWh、逆變效率 0.90，理想續航 4×0.90/8=0.45 h=27 分鐘。 負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: an 8 kW load at power factor 0.8 requires 10 kVA; a 10 kVA UPS does not necessarily support 10 kW. With 4 kWh usable battery energy and 90% inverter efficiency, ideal runtime is 4×0.90/8=0.45 hours=27 minutes. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.

quiz.question: 關於「建立負載清單：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Build a load inventory: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
額定 W、VA、浪湧及峰值因數分別限制供電能力。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Watts, VA, inrush and crest factor impose different supply constraints.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 額定 W、VA、浪湧及峰值因數分別限制供電能力。 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。
quiz.explanationEn: Watts, VA, inrush and crest factor impose different supply constraints. Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately.

steps.failureEn: If build a load inventory disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立負載清單」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.

steps.failure: 若「比較備援式與在線式」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare standby and online ups disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較備援式與在線式」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.textEn: Multiply 0.97 rectifier and 0.96 inverter efficiencies for 93.12%, then add fixed auxiliaries.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：負載 8 kW、功率因數 0.8，需 10 kVA；這不代表 10 kVA UPS 一定能提供 10 kW。若可用電池能量 4 kWh、逆變效率 0.90，理想續航 4×0.90/8=0.45 h=27 分鐘。 負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: an 8 kW load at power factor 0.8 requires 10 kVA; a 10 kVA UPS does not necessarily support 10 kW. With 4 kWh usable battery energy and 90% inverter efficiency, ideal runtime is 4×0.90/8=0.45 hours=27 minutes. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.

quiz.question: 關於「核算雙轉換效率：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Audit double-conversion efficiency: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以整流 0.97、逆變 0.96 算 93.12%，再加入輔機固定用電。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Multiply 0.97 rectifier and 0.96 inverter efficiencies for 93.12%, then add fixed auxiliaries.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 兩級效率相乘，輕載與滿載效率可能不同。 以整流 0.97、逆變 0.96 算 93.12%，再加入輔機固定用電。
quiz.explanationEn: Two conversion efficiencies multiply and can differ between light/full load. Multiply 0.97 rectifier and 0.96 inverter efficiencies for 93.12%, then add fixed auxiliaries.

courses.title: 資料中心備援配電
courses.titleEn: Redundant power distribution for data centers
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討A/B 配電、容量備援、共同失效與運維證據，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore A/B distribution, redundant capacity, common failures and operational evidence, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。可靠度分類、接地及現場切換須按工程規範與合格專業審核；課程只評估離線拓樸。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.

stages.title: 負載與路徑
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成負載與路徑；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete loads and paths through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 盤點單電源與雙電源：建立模型

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 12 kW dual-cord rack normally takes 6 kW from each A/B path, but either 剩餘路徑 must carry 12 kW after the other fails. Rating each path at only 6 kW does not create redundancy. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.

quiz.question: 關於「比較 N+1 與 2N：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？

只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: Remove one module and one full distribution path and test both architectures separately.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

quiz.explanationEn: Spare module capacity and two independent systems address different failures. Remove one module and one full distribution path and test both architectures separately.

steps.title: 辨識低壓單體：建立模型

steps.instruction: 在單體資料中注入一顆低壓，檢查總和偏差是否足以發現。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

courses.title: 電解槽整流電源
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討電解槽極化、整流諧波與電流品質，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore electrolyzer polarization, rectifier harmonics and current quality, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。不提供製氫設備組裝、氣體處理與現場運轉程序；數值用於離線電量與電能核算。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. No hydrogen equipment assembly, gas handling or field operation procedures are provided; numerical work is offline charge/energy accounting.

steps.instruction: 比較線性電阻和帶起始電壓的模型，在低電流區指出差異。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

courses.title: 岸電供應系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

stages.title: 岸船需求
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成岸船需求；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete shore/ship requirements through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解盤點船舶供電需求，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.instruction: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.

steps.failureEn: If inventory ship demand disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer behind one passing number.

knowledge.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：原理
knowledge.text: 船舶電壓、頻率、相序與功率需求需分別匹配岸側能力。
knowledge.textEn: Ship voltage, frequency, phase sequence and power must separately match shore capability.

knowledge.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：證據
knowledge.text: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。
knowledge.textEn: Compare 50/60 Hz and two ship voltages in a requirement matrix and mark conversion needs.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：船舶需 3 MW、功率因數 0.9，至少需 3.333 MVA。若船側線電壓 6.6 kV，平衡三相電流約 291.6 A；50 Hz 岸網轉 60 Hz 船網需真正頻率轉換，變壓器本身不會改變頻率。 船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。

Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

steps.title: 拆分變壓與變頻：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Separate voltage and frequency conversion: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解拆分變壓與變頻，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate voltage and frequency conversion through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在方塊圖將變壓器與 AC/DC/AC 分開，追蹤每端頻率。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Separate transformer and AC/DC/AC blocks and track frequency at every port. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在方塊圖將變壓器與 AC/DC/AC 分開，追蹤每端頻率。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Separate transformer and AC/DC/AC blocks and track frequency at every port. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「拆分變壓與變頻」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate voltage and frequency conversion disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「拆分變壓與變頻」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate voltage and frequency conversion, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 拆分變壓與變頻：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate voltage and frequency conversion: principle
knowledge.text: 變壓器改變電壓比，靜態頻率轉換器才處理頻率差。
knowledge.textEn: Transformers change voltage ratio; static converters handle frequency differences.

knowledge.title: 拆分變壓與變頻：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Separate voltage and frequency conversion: evidence
knowledge.text: 在方塊圖將變壓器與 AC/DC/AC 分開，追蹤每端頻率。
knowledge.textEn: Separate transformer and AC/DC/AC blocks and track frequency at every port.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：船舶需 3 MW、功率因數 0.9，至少需 3.333 MVA。若船側線電壓 6.6 kV，平衡三相電流約 291.6 A；50 Hz 岸網轉 60 Hz 船網需真正頻率轉換，變壓器本身不會改變頻率。 船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 3 MW at power factor 0.9 requires at least 3.333 MVA. At 6.6 kV line voltage the balanced current is about 291.6 A. Converting a 50 Hz shore grid to a 60 Hz ship grid requires frequency conversion; a transformer alone does not change frequency. Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Transformers change voltage ratio; static converters handle frequency differences.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 變壓器改變電壓比，靜態頻率轉換器才處理頻率差。 在方塊圖將變壓器與 AC/DC/AC 分開，追蹤每端頻率。

以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。

Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

steps.title: 安排軸承與同心度：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Arrange bearings and concentricity: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解安排軸承與同心度，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand arrange bearings and concentricity through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「軸承配合與軸系同心度影響振動和壽命，電磁合格不保證機械合格。」的觀察。將機械公差鏈與振動頻譜對照，提出不同於電磁諧波的假說。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Bearing fits and concentricity affect vibration/life; electromagnetic success does not guarantee mechanical success. Compare tolerance stackups with vibration spectra and propose a hypothesis distinct from electromagnetic harmonics. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 將機械公差鏈與振動頻譜對照，提出不同於電磁諧波的假說。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare tolerance stackups with vibration spectra and propose a hypothesis distinct from electromagnetic harmonics. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「安排軸承與同心度」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把定轉子電磁結構、製造公差與電機驗證的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

steps.check: 交付「安排軸承與同心度」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：50 Hz、4 極感應馬達同步轉速 ns=120f/P=1,500 rpm；轉子 1,440 rpm 時滑差 s=(ns−n)/ns=0.04。若氣隙功率 10 kW，理想轉子銅損 sPg=0.4 kW，機械轉換功率 9.6 kW，尚未扣機械損耗。 製造參數取決於材料與設計；本課為圖面、模擬和檢驗資料判讀，無帶電耐壓、加工與轉子超速指令。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: at 50 Hz with four poles, ns=120f/P=1,500 rpm. At 1,440 rpm, slip s=(ns−n)/ns=0.04. For 10 kW air-gap power, ideal rotor copper loss sPg=0.4 kW and converted mechanical power is 9.6 kW before mechanical losses. Manufacturing parameters depend on materials and design; the course interprets drawings, simulations and inspection data, without energized withstand, machining or overspeed instructions.

courses.title: 永磁同步馬達製造
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁鐵裝配、轉子保持及退磁驗證需材料與機械專業；本課無實體高速轉子製造或測試程序。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnet assembly, rotor retention and demagnetization validation need materials/mechanical expertise; no physical high-speed rotor fabrication/testing procedure is given.

stages.title: 磁路與拓樸
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成磁路與拓樸；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete magnetic circuits and topology through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 比較表貼與內埋磁鐵：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Compare surface and interior magnets: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較表貼與內埋磁鐵，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare surface and interior magnets through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 對兩種原創截面標出磁通與橋部，列出可與不可轉移的模型。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark flux and bridges on two original cross sections and list transferable and nontransferable models. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 對兩種原創截面標出磁通與橋部，列出可與不可轉移的模型。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark flux and bridges on two original cross sections and list transferable and nontransferable models. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較表貼與內埋磁鐵」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare surface and interior magnets disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較表貼與內埋磁鐵」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare surface and interior magnets, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example using peak dq currents: a surface-PM machine has T=1.5pψfIq. With p=4, ψf=0.08 Wb and Iq=50 A, T=24 N·m; at 3,000 rpm ideal mechanical power is about 7.54 kW. Do not reuse the coefficient unchanged with RMS conventions. Magnet assembly, rotor retention and demagnetization validation need materials/mechanical expertise; no physical high-speed rotor fabrication/testing procedure is given.

quiz.question: 關於「讀取磁鐵 B–H 曲線：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Read magnet B–H curves: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
比較兩溫度退磁曲線與工作點，指出不可逆退磁風險方向。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Compare demagnetization curves and operating points at two temperatures and identify irreversible-risk direction.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 剩磁、矯頑力與溫度係數各自影響性能，磁鐵牌號不只是一個強度數字。 比較兩溫度退磁曲線與工作點，指出不可逆退磁風險方向。
quiz.explanationEn: Remanence, coercivity and temperature coefficients affect different behaviors; a grade is not one strength number. Compare demagnetization curves and operating points at two temperatures and identify irreversible-risk direction.

steps.title: 建立極對數映射：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Map pole pairs: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立極對數映射，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand map pole pairs through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 四極對轉子旋轉 45° 機械角，驗算 180° 電角。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: For four pole pairs, verify that 45° mechanical equals 180° electrical. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 四極對轉子旋轉 45° 機械角，驗算 180° 電角。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: For four pole pairs, verify that 45° mechanical equals 180° electrical. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立極對數映射」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If map pole pairs disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立極對數映射」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for map pole pairs, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「高轉速反電勢增加，負 d 軸電流可降低磁鏈但佔用電流能力。」的觀察。在電流圓上增加 abs(Id)，計算可剩餘 Iq，連到轉矩降額。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。

courses.title: 開關磁阻馬達控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討磁阻轉矩、相電流成形與換相區間，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore reluctance torque, phase-current shaping and commutation intervals, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁路飽和、非線性和機械噪音不可由單一線性式充分描述；僅做模擬與公開資料判讀。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnetic saturation, nonlinearity and acoustic behavior exceed one linear equation; work is limited to simulation and public-data interpretation.

knowledge.text: 教學例：線性未飽和近似 T≈0.5i²dL/dθ。i=10 A、dL/dθ=0.02 H/rad 時 T≈1 N·m。角度若以度表示需先換為 rad；飽和時必須改用磁共能曲線，不可外推 i²。 磁路飽和、非線性和機械噪音不可由單一線性式充分描述；僅做模擬與公開資料判讀。

Magnetic saturation, nonlinearity and acoustic behavior exceed one linear equation; work is limited to simulation and public-data interpretation.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立 L–θ 曲線，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build l–angle curves through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 對一條示意 L(θ) 曲線標出正、零、負斜率區。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark positive, zero and negative slope regions on an illustrative L(θ) curve. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 對一條示意 L(θ) 曲線標出正、零、負斜率區。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark positive, zero and negative slope regions on an illustrative L(θ) curve. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立 L–θ 曲線」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁阻轉矩、相電流成形與換相區間的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build l–angle curves disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of reluctance torque, phase-current shaping and commutation intervals behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立 L–θ 曲線」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build l–angle curves, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立 L–θ 曲線：原理
knowledge.text: 在相同小電流下電感隨轉角改變，斜率符號決定線性轉矩方向。
knowledge.textEn: At equal small current inductance varies with angle; slope sign sets linear-model torque direction.

knowledge.title: 建立 L–θ 曲線：證據
knowledge.text: 對一條示意 L(θ) 曲線標出正、零、負斜率區。
knowledge.textEn: Mark positive, zero and negative slope regions on an illustrative L(θ) curve.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：線性未飽和近似 T≈0.5i²dL/dθ。i=10 A、dL/dθ=0.02 H/rad 時 T≈1 N·m。角度若以度表示需先換為 rad；飽和時必須改用磁共能曲線，不可外推 i²。 磁路飽和、非線性和機械噪音不可由單一線性式充分描述；僅做模擬與公開資料判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example in the unsaturated linear approximation: T≈0.5i²dL/dθ. With i=10 A and dL/dθ=0.02 H/rad, T≈1 N·m. Angles must be in radians; saturation requires co-energy curves rather than extrapolating i². Magnetic saturation, nonlinearity and acoustic behavior exceed one linear equation; work is limited to simulation and public-data interpretation.

在相同小電流下電感隨轉角改變，斜率符號決定線性轉矩方向。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
At equal small current inductance varies with angle; slope sign sets linear-model torque direction.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 驗證位置誤差敏感度：原理

courses.title: 線性馬達定位平台
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.

stages.title: 行程與力
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成行程與力；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete travel and force through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立負載與行程：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build load and travel requirements: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立負載與行程，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build load and travel requirements through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立負載與行程」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build load and travel requirements disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立負載與行程」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build load and travel requirements, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立負載與行程：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Build load and travel requirements: principle
knowledge.text: 移動質量包含負載、平台與随動電纜，不只是工件重量。
knowledge.textEn: Moving mass includes payload, carriage and moving cables, not the workpiece alone.

knowledge.title: 建立負載與行程：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Build load and travel requirements: evidence
knowledge.text: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。
knowledge.textEn: Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：20 kg 移動負載需 2 m/s² 加速度、外力摩擦共 15 N，理想推力 F=ma+F外=55 N。若此推力占週期 25%、其餘無力，Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N；實際回程與保持力也必須納入。 RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: moving 20 kg at 2 m/s² against 15 N external/friction force requires F=ma+Fexternal=55 N. If this force occupies 25% of a cycle with zero otherwise, Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N. Actual return and holding forces must also be included. RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.

options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

quiz.explanationEn: Moving mass includes payload, carriage and moving cables, not the workpiece alone. Sum mass components and test force demand under ±10% total mass variation.

steps.title: 區分峰值與連續力：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Separate peak and continuous force: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解區分峰值與連續力，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate peak and continuous force through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 把負載周期轉成力—時間圖，分別取峰值和 RMS。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Convert the duty cycle to a force-time trace and calculate peak and RMS separately. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 把負載周期轉成力—時間圖，分別取峰值和 RMS。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Convert the duty cycle to a force-time trace and calculate peak and RMS separately. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「區分峰值與連續力」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate peak and continuous force disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「區分峰值與連續力」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.title: 區分峰值與連續力：原理

knowledge.textEn: Peak force supports brief acceleration; continuous force is thermally bounded.

knowledge.title: 區分峰值與連續力：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Separate peak and continuous force: evidence
knowledge.text: 把負載周期轉成力—時間圖，分別取峰值和 RMS。
knowledge.textEn: Convert the duty cycle to a force-time trace and calculate peak and RMS separately.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：20 kg 移動負載需 2 m/s² 加速度、外力摩擦共 15 N，理想推力 F=ma+F外=55 N。若此推力占週期 25%、其餘無力，Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N；實際回程與保持力也必須納入。 RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。

knowledge.title: 建立雙迴路控制：原理
knowledge.text: 電流環、速度環和位置環需合適頻寬分離，結構共振限制外環。
knowledge.textEn: Current, speed and position loops need bandwidth separation; structural resonance limits outer loops.

knowledge.title: 建立雙迴路控制：證據
knowledge.text: 對比提高位置增益前後的共振峰與整定時間。
knowledge.textEn: Compare resonance peaks and settling times before/after increasing position gain.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：20 kg 移動負載需 2 m/s² 加速度、外力摩擦共 15 N，理想推力 F=ma+F外=55 N。若此推力占週期 25%、其餘無力，Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N；實際回程與保持力也必須納入。 RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。

RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.

courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討六步換相、反電勢偵測與電流控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解配置六步序列，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand configure six-step sequences through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在六區狀態圖追蹤正反轉序列，保持電流方向定義一致。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Trace forward/reverse orders on a six-sector diagram with consistent current signs. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在六區狀態圖追蹤正反轉序列，保持電流方向定義一致。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Trace forward/reverse orders on a six-sector diagram with consistent current signs. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「配置六步序列」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把六步換相、反電勢偵測與電流控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If configure six-step sequences disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of six-step commutation, back-EMF sensing and current regulation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「配置六步序列」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for configure six-step sequences, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 配置六步序列：原理
knowledge.text: 每區段兩相承載、另一相浮接或受特定調變，序列決定轉矩方向。
knowledge.textEn: Two phases conduct per sector while the third is unpowered or modulated; sequence sets torque direction.

knowledge.title: 配置六步序列：證據
knowledge.text: 在六區狀態圖追蹤正反轉序列，保持電流方向定義一致。
knowledge.textEn: Trace forward/reverse orders on a six-sector diagram with consistent current signs.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：四極對馬達轉速 3,000 rpm，電頻率 fe=pn/60=200 Hz。一電週六個換相區間，因此換相事件率 1,200 次/s，每區約 0.833 ms。PWM 頻率與換相頻率是不同變數。 電路操作限於模擬；六步控制不適合用作所有 PMSM 的通用性能保證，電機波形與熱限制須匹配。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: four pole pairs at 3,000 rpm give fe=pn/60=200 Hz. Six sectors per electrical cycle imply 1,200 commutations/s and about 0.833 ms per sector. PWM frequency and commutation frequency are different variables. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

quiz.question: 關於「配置六步序列：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？

每區段兩相承載、另一相浮接或受特定調變，序列決定轉矩方向。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Two phases conduct per sector while the third is unpowered or modulated; sequence sets torque direction.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 每區段兩相承載、另一相浮接或受特定調變，序列決定轉矩方向。 在六區狀態圖追蹤正反轉序列，保持電流方向定義一致。
quiz.explanationEn: Two phases conduct per sector while the third is unpowered or modulated; sequence sets torque direction. Trace forward/reverse orders on a six-sector diagram with consistent current signs.

knowledge.textEn: Use Ri+Ldi/dt at fixed voltage to compare normal rotation and stall.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：四極對馬達轉速 3,000 rpm，電頻率 fe=pn/60=200 Hz。一電週六個換相區間，因此換相事件率 1,200 次/s，每區約 0.833 ms。PWM 頻率與換相頻率是不同變數。 電路操作限於模擬；六步控制不適合用作所有 PMSM 的通用性能保證，電機波形與熱限制須匹配。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: four pole pairs at 3,000 rpm give fe=pn/60=200 Hz. Six sectors per electrical cycle imply 1,200 commutations/s and about 0.833 ms per sector. PWM frequency and commutation frequency are different variables. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

quiz.question: 關於「配置電流限制：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Configure current limits: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
固定電壓下以 Ri+Ldi/dt 模型比較正常轉速與堵轉。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use Ri+Ldi/dt at fixed voltage to compare normal rotation and stall.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 速度控制命令必須經電流限制，堵轉時低反電勢可使電流快速上升。 固定電壓下以 Ri+Ldi/dt 模型比較正常轉速與堵轉。
quiz.explanationEn: Speed commands need current limits; low back-EMF at stall permits rapid current rise. Use Ri+Ldi/dt at fixed voltage to compare normal rotation and stall.

steps.title: 辨識占空比與速度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Distinguish duty and speed: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識占空比與速度，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand distinguish duty and speed through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.

steps.instructionEn: Apply two loads at identical duty and record the steady-speed difference. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 同占空比分別施加兩種負載，記錄穩態轉速差。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Apply two loads at identical duty and record the steady-speed difference. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識占空比與速度」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把六步換相、反電勢偵測與電流控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If distinguish duty and speed disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of six-step commutation, back-EMF sensing and current regulation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識占空比與速度」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for distinguish duty and speed, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討編碼器尺度、角度校準、同步取樣與錯誤診斷，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore encoder scaling, angle calibration, synchronous sampling and diagnostics, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.

courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Line count, bits, update rates and protocol definitions vary; verify datasheets and timing semantics rather than assume interchangeable interfaces.

courses.title: 感測器省略馬達估測
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討反電勢觀測器、低速可觀測性與估測融合，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore back-EMF observers, low-speed observability and estimator fusion, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Estimator suitability depends on motor, speed, saturation and signals; do not claim real-machine angle accuracy without reference measurements.

stages.title: 模型與可觀測性
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成模型與可觀測性；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete models and observability through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立電壓模型：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build voltage models: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立電壓模型，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build voltage models through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。

courses.title: 再生煞車電力回收
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore kinetic energy, regenerative torque and storage acceptance, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.

courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解交付駕駛週期能量帳，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand deliver drive-cycle energy ledgers through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「單次回生峰值不等於整段路線節能，需累計完整週期。」的觀察。分列牽引、回收、摩擦、阻力及輔機能量，驗證總和。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Peak regeneration is not route energy savings; integrate the complete cycle. Separate traction, recovery, friction, drag and auxiliary energies and reconcile the total. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 分列牽引、回收、摩擦、阻力及輔機能量，驗證總和。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Separate traction, recovery, friction, drag and auxiliary energies and reconcile the total. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「交付駕駛週期能量帳」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If deliver drive-cycle energy ledgers disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of kinetic energy, regenerative torque and storage acceptance behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「交付駕駛週期能量帳」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for deliver drive-cycle energy ledgers, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 交付駕駛週期能量帳：證據
knowledge.text: 分列牽引、回收、摩擦、阻力及輔機能量，驗證總和。
knowledge.textEn: Separate traction, recovery, friction, drag and auxiliary energies and reconcile the total.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：1,500 kg 車輛由 20 m/s 降至 10 m/s，動能差 0.5m(v₁²−v₂²)=225 kJ=62.5 Wh；若機電回收效率 70%，最多回收 43.75 Wh，尚需扣除其他限制造成的損失。 這是離線功率與控制課，不是道路車輛煞車改裝指南；制動安全與功能安全需獨立專業驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1,500 kg vehicle slowing from 20 to 10 m/s loses 0.5m(v₁²−v₂²)=225 kJ=62.5 Wh. At 70% recovery efficiency, at most 43.75 Wh is recovered before other limits. This is offline power/control education, not a road-vehicle braking modification guide; braking and functional safety need independent professional validation.

courses.title: 高速馬達磁浮軸承
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

stages.title: 磁力與氣隙

steps.instruction: 畫出兩個徑向軸承及一個軸向控制概念，數清受控自由度。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.

knowledge.text: 教學例：簡化吸力 F≈kI²/g²，若電流固定而氣隙由 1.0 降至 0.8 mm，吸力增至 1/0.8²=1.5625 倍。轉子越靠近磁極吸力越強，顯示需主動穩定；此式忽略飽和和漏磁。 磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: approximate attraction F≈kI²/g². At fixed current reducing gap from 1.0 to 0.8 mm raises force by 1/0.8²=1.5625. Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: approximate attraction F≈kI²/g². At fixed current reducing gap from 1.0 to 0.8 mm raises force by 1/0.8²=1.5625. Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「限制控制飽和：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Limit control saturation: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
在相同擾動下比較有無限幅模型，記錄碰到氣隙邊界的時刻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Compare limited/unlimited models under one disturbance and record gap-boundary crossings.
quiz.explanation: 力或電流飽和會使原線性穩定分析失效。 在相同擾動下比較有無限幅模型，記錄碰到氣隙邊界的時刻。
quiz.explanationEn: Force/current saturation invalidates the original linear stability analysis. Compare limited/unlimited models under one disturbance and record gap-boundary crossings.

stages.title: 失效與驗證
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成失效與驗證；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete failures and validation through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 分析備援支承：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Analyze backup support: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分析備援支承，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand analyze backup support through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 建立概念失效樹，把控制電源、位置感測和支承能力分開。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Build a conceptual fault tree separating control power, sensing and backup support capacity. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 建立概念失效樹，把控制電源、位置感測和支承能力分開。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build a conceptual fault tree separating control power, sensing and backup support capacity. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分析備援支承」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If analyze backup support disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分析備援支承」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for analyze backup support, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

courses.title: 碳化矽牽引逆變器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

stages.title: 損耗與冷卻

stages.descriptionEn: Complete losses and cooling through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立損耗地圖，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.instruction: 重算本課 50 W 與 40 W，再把 fs 加倍比較總損耗。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

knowledge.text: 導通與開關損耗對電流、頻率和溫度的依賴不同。

courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討GaN 寄生、反向導通與高頻量測限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore GaN parasitics, reverse conduction and high-frequency measurement limits, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。不同 GaN 技術的門極電壓、反向行為和動態電阻不同；不能把矽 MOSFET 或某一 GaN 的設定直接套用。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Gate voltage, reverse behavior and dynamic resistance differ across GaN technologies; do not transfer silicon or one GaN device’s settings blindly.
