courses.title: 諧振 LLC 電源設計
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討LLC 雙諧振、增益曲線與軟切換邊界，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore LLC dual resonances, gain curves and soft-switching bounds, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。基波近似用於初步理解，輕載、啟動與大偏離諧振時需時域模型；本課不提供高壓實機調機程序。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Fundamental-harmonic approximation is introductory; light load, startup and operation far from resonance need time-domain models, with no live high-voltage tuning instructions.

knowledge.text: 教學例：Lr=20 μH、Cr=100 nF，串聯諧振 fr=1/(2π√(LrCr))≈112.54 kHz。若 Lm=100 μH，另一理想頻率 1/(2π√((Lr+Lm)Cr))≈45.94 kHz。實際 LLC 增益還依負載、變壓器比及寄生而變。 基波近似用於初步理解，輕載、啟動與大偏離諧振時需時域模型；本課不提供高壓實機調機程序。

Fundamental-harmonic approximation is introductory; light load, startup and operation far from resonance need time-domain models, with no live high-voltage tuning instructions.

steps.instruction: 用固定 Lm/Lr 掃兩種負載，觀察增益峰值移動。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

knowledge.text: 教學例：Lr=20 μH、Cr=100 nF，串聯諧振 fr=1/(2π√(LrCr))≈112.54 kHz。若 Lm=100 μH，另一理想頻率 1/(2π√((Lr+Lm)Cr))≈45.94 kHz。實際 LLC 增益還依負載、變壓器比及寄生而變。 基波近似用於初步理解，輕載、啟動與大偏離諧振時需時域模型；本課不提供高壓實機調機程序。

courses.title: 雙主動橋雙向轉換器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討雙橋相移、漏感功率傳遞與雙向控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore dual-bridge phase shift, leakage-inductance power transfer and bidirectional control, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。公式假設理想方波、忽略磁化與電阻且採定義一致的單相移；大相移和電壓失配需檢查 RMS 電流及 ZVS 邊界。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. The formula assumes ideal square waves, neglected magnetizing/resistive effects and consistent single-phase-shift definitions; large shifts and mismatch require RMS-current/ZVS checks.

stages.title: 拓樸與參考
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成拓樸與參考；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete topology and references through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識兩側主動橋：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Identify both active bridges: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識兩側主動橋，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand identify both active bridges through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在原創方塊圖標記兩側 DC 電容、橋、變壓器及串聯電感。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark DC capacitors, bridges, transformer and series inductance in an original block diagram. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在原創方塊圖標記兩側 DC 電容、橋、變壓器及串聯電感。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark DC capacitors, bridges, transformer and series inductance in an original block diagram. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識兩側主動橋」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把雙橋相移、漏感功率傳遞與雙向控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If identify both active bridges disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of dual-bridge phase shift, leakage-inductance power transfer and bidirectional control behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識兩側主動橋」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for identify both active bridges, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 辨識兩側主動橋：原理
knowledge.text: DAB 兩側皆可切換，功率方向由相位與控制決定，不靠翻轉接線。
knowledge.textEn: Both DAB bridges switch; phase/control sets power direction without rewiring.

knowledge.title: 辨識兩側主動橋：證據
knowledge.text: 在原創方塊圖標記兩側 DC 電容、橋、變壓器及串聯電感。
knowledge.textEn: Mark DC capacitors, bridges, transformer and series inductance in an original block diagram.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想單相移 DAB，P=V1·V2′/(ωL)·φ(1−abs(φ)/π)，V2′為折算至一次側的方波幅值，φ 用 rad。V1=V2′=400 V、f=100 kHz、L=20 μH、φ=π/6，P≈5.56 kW；反向 φ 改符號。 公式假設理想方波、忽略磁化與電阻且採定義一致的單相移；大相移和電壓失配需檢查 RMS 電流及 ZVS 邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example for ideal single-phase-shift DAB: P=V1·V2′/(ωL)·φ(1−abs(φ)/π), with V2′ the secondary square-wave amplitude referred to the primary and φ in radians. At V1=V2′=400 V, f=100 kHz, L=20 μH and φ=π/6, P≈5.56 kW. Reversing φ reverses power. The formula assumes ideal square waves, neglected magnetizing/resistive effects and consistent single-phase-shift definitions; large shifts and mismatch require RMS-current/ZVS checks.

steps.title: 核對 DC 偏磁：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Check DC flux bias: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解核對 DC 偏磁，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand check dc flux bias through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 積分兩半週伏秒，加入一個時間偏差觀察磁通漂移。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate both half-cycle volt-seconds and inject a timing offset to observe flux drift. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 積分兩半週伏秒，加入一個時間偏差觀察磁通漂移。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Integrate both half-cycle volt-seconds and inject a timing offset to observe flux drift. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「核對 DC 偏磁」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把雙橋相移、漏感功率傳遞與雙向控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If check dc flux bias disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of dual-bridge phase shift, leakage-inductance power transfer and bidirectional control behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「核對 DC 偏磁」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想單相移 DAB，P=V1·V2′/(ωL)·φ(1−abs(φ)/π)，V2′為折算至一次側的方波幅值，φ 用 rad。V1=V2′=400 V、f=100 kHz、L=20 μH、φ=π/6，P≈5.56 kW；反向 φ 改符號。 公式假設理想方波、忽略磁化與電阻且採定義一致的單相移；大相移和電壓失配需檢查 RMS 電流及 ZVS 邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example for ideal single-phase-shift DAB: P=V1·V2′/(ωL)·φ(1−abs(φ)/π), with V2′ the secondary square-wave amplitude referred to the primary and φ in radians. At V1=V2′=400 V, f=100 kHz, L=20 μH and φ=π/6, P≈5.56 kW. Reversing φ reverses power. The formula assumes ideal square waves, neglected magnetizing/resistive effects and consistent single-phase-shift definitions; large shifts and mismatch require RMS-current/ZVS checks.

courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討線電流成形、功率因數、諧波與雙迴路控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore line-current shaping, power factor, harmonics and dual-loop control, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.

courses.title: 隔離式閘極驅動器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討隔離門極時序、CMTI、Miller 抑制與故障回報，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore isolated-gate timing, CMTI, Miller suppression and fault reporting, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。隔離額定、爬電距離和保護時間須按器件與應用規範審核；本課無高壓實機量測連接方法。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Isolation ratings, creepage and protection timing require device/application review; no high-voltage physical probing instructions are included.

stages.descriptionEn: Complete isolation and bias through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：總閘極電荷 Qg=100 nC、目標電荷轉移時間 100 ns，簡化平均驅動電流 Qg/t=1 A。實際峰流由門極電阻、驅動器輸出阻抗與 Miller 平台決定；用 Qg·ΔV·fs 估平均閘極驅動功率。 隔離額定、爬電距離和保護時間須按器件與應用規範審核；本課無高壓實機量測連接方法。

steps.instruction: 在離線模型降低偏壓，追蹤輸出狀態及恢復遲滯。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

knowledge.text: 教學例：Rshunt=1 mΩ、I=50 A，壓降 50 mV、耗散 I²R=2.5 W。若增益 20 V/V，輸出訊號增量 1 V；輸入偏移 25 μV 相當於 25 mA 電流誤差，不包含增益、溫漂和 ADC 誤差。 感測器頻寬或量測精度不代表保護已足夠；隔離、過載和故障切離需獨立證據，不提供實機故障注入指令。

Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.

steps.instruction: 對短雜訊脈波和持續過流兩個合成輸入比較輸出。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

history.title: 能源研究園區啟用
history.text: Risø 於 1958 年啟用；其研究重心後來逐步轉向永續能源。這段沿革顯示大型能源技術需要長期場域與量測能力。
history.textEn: Risø opened in 1958 and later shifted toward sustainable energy, illustrating the long-lived facilities and measurement capability needed for energy research.

history.title: 公開海上風機參考模型
history.text: NREL 與 DTU 合作的 IEA 15 MW 參考風機提供公開比較基準；本課使用其研究脈絡，不把參考模型視為產品製造規格。
history.textEn: The NREL/DTU IEA 15-MW reference turbine provides an open comparison baseline; this course uses its research context rather than treating it as a commercial manufacturing specification.

places.connection: 從辨識能量邊界的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
places.connectionEn: Start with define energy boundaries and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.
